name: Resupplying the Excavation
summary: Resupplying the Excavation is an Alliance quest in Loch Modan where adventurers pursue a powder shipment meant for Ironband's Excavation Site. Dispatched by Jern Hornhelm to catch up with the pack team, the traveler follows their route along the shore of the Loch.

sections.title: A Heavy Cargo along the Shore
sections.body: Ironband's Excavation Site in southern Loch Modan requires a steady supply of blastpowder to uncover ancient titan artifacts buried deep within the mountains. After blastpowder was delivered to Thelsamar, local quartermaster Jern Hornhelm arranged for three dwarves—Huldar, Miran, and Saean—to haul the volatile barrels south along the lakeside road. Burdened by the weighty cargo, the supply party moved slowly, giving travelers in Thelsamar an opportunity to catch up and lend support on the road.

sections.title: Treachery in the Shadows
sections.body: Catching up to the pack wagon along the southern road reveals chaos rather than a routine delivery. The shipment was ambushed by Dark Iron dwarves, who actively seek to sabotage the Bronzebeard expedition's archaeological efforts. Worse than the raid itself, the attack exposed bitter treachery: Saean, a worker trusted and employed alongside Huldar for nearly a year, proved to be a Dark Iron sympathizer who assisted in organizing the ambush.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Resupplying the Excavation?
aliases: where to start resupplying the excavation
faq.answer: Jern Hornhelm offers the quest in Thelsamar after you bring him the blastpowder. He asks you to follow the road south along the Loch to catch up with the supply team.

faq.q: Where can Huldar and the wagon be found?
aliases: where is the wagon loch modan
faq.answer: Huldar and the wagon are located south of Thelsamar, following the road that hugs the western and southern curve of the Loch heading toward Ironband's Excavation Site.

faq.q: Why is blastpowder being sent to Ironband?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband and his team are unearthing ancient earthen ruins and relics at the southern excavation site. Blastpowder is needed to break apart heavy stone and blast through subterranean layers.
Jern expects the supply team to be on the normal road south of Thelsamar, following the Loch. What has happened to the wagon is revealed when you reach Huldar.

faq.q: What role did Saean play in the attack?
faq.answer: Saean is traveling with Huldar and Miran to move the heavy blastpowder barrels. His role in the events on the road is revealed when you catch up with the team.

faq.q: What quest comes next after finding Huldar?
aliases: next quest after resupplying the excavation
faq.answer: Speaking with Huldar completes this leg of the journey. His account of the shipment provides the next lead.

angles.text: For Bronzebeard dwarves, protecting the blastpowder shipment helps keep Ironband's work supplied despite the dangers on Loch Modan's roads.
Moving volatile blasting powder across rough terrain is hazardous enough without treachery, making this shipment essential for the excavators down south.
